title: Risk Rating Methods in Threat Modeling

scenes.line1: How do you decide which threats
scenes.say: Ever wonder how security teams pick which threats to tackle first? Let's break down risk rating methods.

scenes.label: DREAD
scenes.sub: Scores threats by damage, exploitability, and more.
scenes.say: DREAD is a classic model. It scores each threat by damage, how easy it is to exploit, and other factors.
CVSS is an industry standard with detailed scoring. Or, you might use a quick matrix that multiplies likelihood by impact.
A high DREAD score means fix it now. Medium scores get scheduled soon. Low scores can be deferred if resources are tight.

scenes.question: Why do we use risk rating?
scenes.right: To focus on the most critical threats first
scenes.say: Don't just list threats. Risk rating helps you focus on the most critical issues first.
